index 30c170b..e0ec956 100644
--- a/lib/slug.mjs
+++ b/lib/slug.mjs
@@ -1,3 +1,19 @@
+// Strips diacritics (U+0300–U+036F) exposed by NFD normalization.
+const COMBINING_MARKS = /[̀-ͯ]/g
+
 export function slugify(input) {
-  throw new Error('slugify is not implemented yet')
+  return String(input)
+    .normalize('NFD')
+    .replace(COMBINING_MARKS, '')
+    .toLowerCase()
+    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
+    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
+}
+
+export function uniqueSlug(base, existing) {
+  const taken = new Set(existing)
+  if (!taken.has(base)) return base
+  let n = 2
+  while (taken.has(`${base}-${n}`)) n++
+  return `${base}-${n}`
 }

artifacts.content:
All 4 tests pass. Summary of what was missing and what I implemented:

## Diagnosis
Both `slugify` and `uniqueSlug` were missing:
- `lib/slug.mjs` — `slugify` was a stub that just threw `Error('slugify is not implemented yet')`
- `index.mjs` — only re-exported `slugify`, and never exported `uniqueSlug` at all (this caused the `SyntaxError` that failed the whole test file before any test could run)

## Changes
**`lib/slug.mjs`** — implemented both functions:
- `slugify(input)`: coerces to string → NFD-normalizes and strips combining marks (accents) → lowercases → replaces any run of non-alphanumerics with a single `-` → trims leading/trailing dashes. This handles the test cases `'Hello World'`, `'  Héllo, World!  '`, and `'a --  b'`.
- `uniqueSlug(base, existing)`: returns `base` if unused, otherwise scans `-2`, `-3`, … until it finds a suffix not in `existing` (using a `Set` for O(1) lookup).

**`index.mjs`** — added `uniqueSlug` to the re-export:
```js
export { slugify, uniqueSlug } from './lib/slug.mjs'
```

## Verification
```
# tests 4
# pass 4
# fail 0
```
Also spot-checked beyond the test suite: `slugify('Crème Brûlée Recipe')` → `creme-brulee-recipe`, and `uniqueSlug('post', ['post','post-2','post-3'])` → `post-4`.
